RTA_TARGET_BIN_HZ.doc: The RTA's target bin resolution — generated into `omx_contract_limits.h` as `OMX_RTA_TARGET_BIN_HZ`, which `mix_dsp.h` reads; the engine's conformance test reads it back from the header.

RTA_FFT_SIZE_MAX.doc: The largest RTA FFT the native ring holds — generated into `omx_contract_limits.h` as `OMX_RTA_FFT_SIZE_MAX`.

RTA_BAND_F_MIN.doc: The lowest frequency any spectrum band covers; below it is infrasonic and not drawn.

RTA_BAND_F_MAX_CAP.doc: The highest frequency any spectrum band covers, before the Nyquist clamp (omx_rta_band_f_max).

RTA_TIER_CROSSOVER_HZ.doc: A band centred below this samples the LOW (decimated) tier when the reading carries one; at or above it, the HIGH tier. Where the high tier's ~5.86 Hz bins still give ~51 bins per octave, above the finest panel's density.

RTA_BAND_GATE_DB.doc: Quiet gate of the band reduction: when no band rises above this, every band reads as silence, so a rig's idle floor never draws as a flat block. Keyed on the loudest band, not per band.
